speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: All missions are enabled by the consistent investment in training and equipping over the years.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We thank Singaporeans for their support of our SAF.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our SAF remains ready to execute our missions in service of our nation.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: My supplementary question arises out of our deployment of our Multi-Role Tankers Transport.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I think our airmen and soldiers, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) and MINDEF should be commended.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: It was a complex high-altitude mission, and it was successful.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: My supplementary question is borne out of my request that an exhibition be included, of this exercise, in the syllabus of the Officer Cadet School's Air Wing or Specialist Command School, so that NSmen and our soldiers, both men and women, can learn from the courage and the complexity of these successful multi-faceted rescue operations and evacuation operations.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: So, would the Minister for Defence consider providing an inclusion of syllabus in the teaching of the commanders in our National Service, where we can glean extremely good lessons from successful missions such as these.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: And finally, I would just like to thank all Members for your support, because as the Chinese saying goes, "台上一分钟，台下十年功".
